# Integration tests that must run and pass in CI on each operating system.
# Format: <os|all> <package> <Test[/subtest]>. The os column uses RUNNER_OS
# (Linux, Windows). A missing, skipped, renamed or failing entry fails CI,
# so a green run can't hide an integration that silently stopped running.
